knesset.prompt: Which law? For example חוק הגנת הפרטיות or [[חוק:חופש המידע]]
knesset.enable: Turn on Knesset sources? Lumen then sends law and bill names to knesset.gov.il when you ask, and never on its own.
knesset.confirm: Look up “{name}” in the Knesset's records? Only the name is sent to knesset.gov.il, nothing from your notes. Saved laws open without asking.
knesset.saved: Saved to {path}. Paste the law's text under “## נוסח” to ask it questions.
knesset.billPrompt: Which bill? A word from its name
knesset.protocolSelect: Open a committee protocol and select the words to quote first.
knesset.protocolNotFound: These words are not in a speaker's turn in this protocol.
knesset.askPrompt: Ask the laws you saved (searched on this device)
knesset.askNone: No saved law answers that. The search reads only laws saved for offline, with their text.
knesset.askPickQuote: Sections to quote — quotes from the law, not verified answers
knesset.quoteNotInCopy: quote not found in the saved copy
knesset.quoteNotAnswer: Quote from the law, not a verified answer.
knesset.answerVerified: Checked by the critic: section {section} supports this answer.
knesset.answerNotVerified: Not verified: the critic could not confirm this answer from section {section}. Rely on the quote.
